title: Button state color effects discarded — identity CXForm always emitted in ButtonRecord
description: buildButtonRecord() in buttons.ts always emits identity CXFormWithAlpha (256,256,256,256,0,0,0,0) regardless of any colorEffect on the state display object. Fix: if colorEffect present, encode it as the ButtonRecord CXFormWithAlpha using the same logic as PlaceObject2 colorEffect encoding in compile.ts.
